trickyParts: escapedTilde counts backslashes only inside the text node goldmark appended before the parser call, so a backslash a bare URL took is not an escape (micromark reads it as the URL's).

nearestOpener files openers in buckets by (rule-of-three length mod 3, can close); ruleLength is the remaining length for */_ and the written length for ~, matching what CalcComsumption reads. Checked equivalent to the plain walk on 200,000 random inputs (2.7M closer lookups, 0 mismatches) before the walk was removed.
Inside a pair a pass of the other group runs at once; depth is bounded because the outer pair already removed its own group's runs.
deviations: Corpus row ~~~a~~~ became b ~~~a~~~ (a line starting ~~~ is a fence in both readers).
parseImage now adds a nested image's alt text to the outer alt (the engine's reading); the differential flagged it once strikes formed.
Rule-of-three bucket lookup added: emphasis pairing was quadratic at main on **a then a*a (100 s at 437 KiB); fixed here since this pull request owns the pairing code.

Round 2: the tester's regression came from separate passes pairing a `**` (after `~~`, close-only by flanking) with the outer `*`; micromark counts `~` as an attention marker, so that `**` can both open and close and the rule of three keeps it apart. INFRA-535's classification is therefore in this pull request, per the INFRA-138 architect.
